name: Build Floodman Operations AIO v3.3.0

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - 'floodman-source.zip'
      - '.github/workflows/build-floodman-aio-v3.3.0.yml'

permissions:
  contents: read
  packages: write

concurrency:
  group: floodman-aio-v3.3.0-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate Floodman source bundle
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test -f floodman-source.zip || { echo 'Upload floodman-source.zip to the repository root.'; exit 1; }
          python - <<'PY'
          import pathlib, zipfile
          archive = pathlib.Path('floodman-source.zip')
          with zipfile.ZipFile(archive) as z:
              names = set(z.namelist())
              required = {
                  'floodman-source/VERSION',
                  'floodman-source/source.json',
                  'floodman-source/MANIFEST.sha256',
                  'floodman-source/overlay/opt/floodman/aio/start-suite.sh',
                  'floodman-source/overlay/opt/floodman/hub/hub.js',
                  'floodman-source/overlay/opt/floodman/office-console/app/customer_csv.py',
              }
              missing = sorted(required - names)
              if missing:
                  raise SystemExit(f'Missing required source paths: {missing}')
              if any(name.startswith('/') or '..' in pathlib.PurePosixPath(name).parts for name in names):
                  raise SystemExit('Unsafe path found in floodman-source.zip')
              version = z.read('floodman-source/VERSION').decode().strip()
              if version != '3.3.0':
                  raise SystemExit(f'Expected source version 3.3.0, got {version!r}')
          print('Floodman source archive structure is valid.')
          PY

      - name: Create derivative runtime Dockerfile
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cat > Dockerfile.floodman-v3.3.0 <<'DOCKERFILE'
          FROM ghcr.io/theninjallo/floodman-business-suite-aio:3.2.2

          LABEL org.opencontainers.image.title="Floodman Operations AIO"
          LABEL org.opencontainers.image.description="Floodman-branded Pterodactyl AIO with client files, signed-document filing, and customer CSV import."
          LABEL org.opencontainers.image.version="3.3.0"
          LABEL org.opencontainers.image.authors="Josh Aldrich"
          LABEL org.opencontainers.image.source="https://github.com/TheNINJALLO/floodman-business-suite-aio"

          USER root
          COPY floodman-source.zip /tmp/floodman-source.zip
          RUN rm -rf /tmp/floodman-source \
              && mkdir -p /tmp/floodman-source \
              && unzip -q /tmp/floodman-source.zip -d /tmp/floodman-source \
              && cd /tmp/floodman-source/floodman-source \
              && test "$(cat VERSION)" = "3.3.0" \
              && sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256 \
              && rm -rf /opt/floodman \
              && mkdir -p /opt/floodman \
              && cp -a overlay/opt/floodman/. /opt/floodman/ \
              && chmod 0755 /opt/floodman/aio/*.sh \
              && chmod -R a+rX /opt/floodman \
              && printf '%s\n' '3.3.0' > /opt/floodman/RUNTIME_VERSION \
              && rm -rf /tmp/floodman-source /tmp/floodman-source.zip

          ENV FLOODMAN_CREATOR_NAME="Josh Aldrich"
          ENV FLOODMAN_PRODUCT_NAME="Floodman Operations"
          ENV FLOODMAN_SOURCE_VERSION="3.3.0"

          USER container
          WORKDIR /home/container
          ENTRYPOINT ["/usr/local/bin/floodman-pterodactyl-entrypoint"]
          CMD ["bash", "./mobile-start.sh"]
          DOCKERFILE

      - name: Validate visible-brand and feature files
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rm -rf source-check
          unzip -q floodman-source.zip -d source-check
          cd source-check/floodman-source
          sha256sum -c MANIFEST.sha256 >/dev/null
          grep -F 'Created by Josh Aldrich' overlay/opt/floodman/office-console/app/ui.py
          grep -F 'Customer Files' overlay/opt/floodman/hub/hub.js
          grep -F '/internal/v1/client-files/attach' overlay/opt/floodman/office-console/app/main.py
          grep -F '/office/imports/customers/upload' overlay/opt/floodman/office-console/app/main.py
          ! grep -F 'Gauzy' overlay/opt/floodman/hub/starting.html
          ! grep -F 'Gauzy' overlay/opt/floodman/office-console/app/ui.py
          ! grep -F 'Gauzy' overlay/opt/floodman/office-console/app/main.py
          echo 'Floodman visible-brand and workflow checks passed.'

      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@v3

      - name: Sign in to GitHub Container Registry
        uses: docker/login-action@v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build and publish Floodman Operations v3.3.0
        uses: docker/build-push-action@v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: ./Dockerfile.floodman-v3.3.0
          platforms: linux/amd64
          pull: true
          push: true
          tags: |
            ghcr.io/theninjallo/floodman-business-suite-aio:3.3.0
            ghcr.io/theninjallo/floodman-business-suite-aio:3.2.0
            ghcr.io/theninjallo/floodman-business-suite-aio:latest-mobile-test
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max
          provenance: mode=max
          sbom: true
